highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.158.0 previews the Skia m158 engine while preserving the existing managed API surface.
highlights_body: HarfBuzzSharp packages move to revision 14.4.0.300; the bundled HarfBuzz engine remains at 14.4.0.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer from Skia m157 to m158 without changing managed wrappers, generated bindings or C API declarations.

preview_summaries.v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2: Preview 1 introduces the Skia m158 engine with the existing managed API surface. HarfBuzzSharp packages move to revision 14.4.0.300 without upgrading the native HarfBuzz 14.4.0 engine.

v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2.headline: SkiaSharp 4.158.0 Preview 1 updates the bundled renderer to Skia m158.
v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2.body: The managed API surface is unchanged. HarfBuzzSharp packages move to revision 14.4.0.300 while the bundled HarfBuzz engine stays at 14.4.0.
